evidence.stale_guidance_conflict: rollouts/AGENTS.md currently says rollouts owns target-aware oracle scorers, rollout-generation recipes, and nbv-build-rollouts; the revised plan moves those responsibilities to rri_metrics.oracle and pipelines.rollout_generation.
direct_source_findings: rollouts/target_counterfactuals.py implements target crop policy, TargetRriInvalidError, target/scene rollout scorer logic, root/current eval assembly, and target reward conversion.
rollouts/counterfactuals.py implements scene CounterfactualOracleRriScorer plus root-normalized gain, log gain, and eval-depth helper logic.
rri_metrics/oracle/scorer.py owns the base OracleRRI point-mesh facade.
rri_metrics/oracle/evidence.py owns root evaluation point-cloud construction and ASE GT depth versus semidense source semantics.
rollouts/dataset_writer.py, rollouts/shards.py, and rollouts/cli.py implement top-level data-generation orchestration.
rri_metrics/metrics/multi_step.py mixes core differentiable rollout returns with non-core candidate diagnostics.

decision.summary: Deepen rri_metrics.oracle for RRI oracle label semantics, move rollout data-generation orchestration to pipelines.rollout_generation, narrow rollouts to replay/storage/inspection, then complete the smaller rri_metrics navigation cleanup.
decision.top_level_oracle_package: Do not create aria_nbv.oracle now; one real oracle family means the seam is hypothetical.
explicit_adapter_seam: rri_metrics.oracle owns oracle-label computation: evidence construction, target crop policy, invalidity, point-mesh scoring, root/log gain conversion, and candidate score selection.
rollouts owns replay-facing adapters: CounterfactualCandidateEvaluation and CounterfactualMetricBundle remain rollouts-owned for the first implementation pass.
rri_metrics.oracle.rollout_scorers may import replay adapter DTOs as adapter targets, but must not own Zarr fields, persistence, branch schedules, or selected-action replay state.
If a proven import cycle appears, introduce a narrow oracle-owned scorer-result DTO such as OracleCandidateScores and convert it to CounterfactualCandidateEvaluation outside rri_metrics.oracle.
pipelines_interface: pipelines.oracle_rri_labeler remains the single-step scene RRI/VIN label pipeline.
pipelines.rollout_generation becomes the public module for target-RRI rollout build/plan/status orchestration.
User-facing command names stay unchanged: nbv-build-rollouts, nbv-plan-rollout-shards, nbv-status-rollout-shards.
